title: चतुर्नवत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Brihadashva promises that his son Kuvalashva will kill Dhundhu. Markandeya then tells how the demons Madhu and Kaitabha, born while Vishnu slept on the cosmic waters, threatened Brahma, and asked to be killed where the ground was not covered by water; Vishnu laid their heads on his bare thighs and cut them off.
summary.kn: ತನ್ನ ಮಗ ಕುವಲಾಶ್ವನು ಧುಂಧುವನ್ನು ಕೊಲ್ಲುವನೆಂದು ಬೃಹದಶ್ವನು ವಾಗ್ದಾನ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ವಿಷ್ಣು ಪ್ರಳಯಜಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಮಲಗಿದ್ದಾಗ ಹುಟ್ಟಿದ ಮಧುಕೈಟಭರು ಬ್ರಹ್ಮನಿಗೆ ಭೀತಿ ಒಡ್ಡಿ, ನೀರು ಮುಚ್ಚದ ನೆಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೊಲ್ಲೆಂದು ಕೇಳಿದಾಗ ವಿಷ್ಣು ಅವರ ತಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ತನ್ನ ಬರಿ ತೊಡೆಗಳ ಮೇಲಿಟ್ಟು ಕತ್ತರಿಸಿದ್ದನ್ನು ಮಾರ್ಕಂಡೇಯರು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: बृहदश्व वचन देते हैं कि उनका पुत्र कुवलाश्व धुन्धु को मारेगा। फिर मार्कण्डेय बताते हैं कि विष्णु के प्रलय-जल पर सोते समय जन्मे दैत्य मधु और कैटभ ने ब्रह्मा को डराया और ऐसी जगह मारे जाने की माँग की जो जल से ढकी न हो; विष्णु ने उनके सिर अपनी खुली जाँघों पर रखकर काट डाले।
summary.te: తన కుమారుడు కువలాశ్వుడు ధుంధును సంహరిస్తాడని బృహదశ్వుడు వాగ్దానం చేస్తాడు. విష్ణువు ప్రళయజలంపై నిద్రిస్తుండగా పుట్టిన మధుకైటభులు బ్రహ్మను భయపెట్టి, నీరు కప్పని నేలపై చంపమని కోరగా విష్ణువు వారి తలలను తన తెరచిన తొడలపై ఉంచి నరికిన కథను మార్కండేయుడు చెబుతాడు.
summary.ta: தன் மகன் குவலாஶ்வன் துந்துவைக் கொல்வான் என்று ப்ருஹதஶ்வன் வாக்களிக்கிறான். விஷ்ணு ஊழி நீரில் துயிலும்போது பிறந்த மது, கைடபர் ப்ரஹ்மாவை அச்சுறுத்தி, நீர் மூடாத இடத்தில் கொல்லப்பட வேண்டினர்; விஷ்ணு அவர்கள் தலைகளைத் தம் திறந்த தொடைகளில் வைத்து வெட்டியதை மார்க்கண்டேயர் சொல்கிறார்.
summary.ml: തന്റെ പുത്രൻ കുവലാശ്വൻ ധുന്ധുവിനെ വധിക്കുമെന്ന് ബൃഹദശ്വൻ വാക്കു നൽകുന്നു. പിന്നെ മാർക്കണ്ഡേയൻ പറയുന്നു: വിഷ്ണു പ്രപഞ്ചജലത്തിൽ ശയിക്കുമ്പോൾ ജനിച്ച മധുവും കൈടഭനും ബ്രഹ്മാവിനെ ഭീഷണിപ്പെടുത്തി; ജലം മൂടാത്ത സ്ഥലത്ത് തങ്ങളെ വധിക്കണമെന്ന് അവർ ആവശ്യപ്പെട്ടു; വിഷ്ണു തന്റെ നഗ്നമായ തുടയിൽ അവരുടെ തലകൾ വെച്ച് അറുത്തു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.194; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

meaning.en: Markandeya said:

verses.text:
स एवमुक्तो राजर्षिरुत्तङ्केनापराजितः ।
उत्तङ्कं कौरवश्रेष्ठ कृताञ्जलिरथाब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Spoken to thus by Uttanka, the unconquered royal sage then answered Uttanka with folded hands, best of the Kurus.

verses.text:
न तेऽभिगमनं ब्रह्मन्मोघमेतद्भविष्यति ।
पुत्रो ममायं भगवन्कुवलाश्व इति स्मृतः ॥

meaning.en: Brahmin, your coming will not be in vain. This son of mine, revered one, is called Kuvalashva.

verses.text:
धृतिमान्क्षिप्रकारी च वीर्येणाप्रतिमो भुवि ।
प्रियं वै सर्वमेतत्ते करिष्यति न संशयः ॥

meaning.en: He is steady, quick in action and unmatched in valour on earth; he will do all this that you wish, without doubt.

verses.text:
पुत्रैः परिवृतः सर्वैः शूरैः परिघबाहुभिः ।
विसर्जयस्व मां ब्रह्मन्न्यस्तशस्त्रोऽस्मि सांप्रतम् ॥

meaning.en: Surrounded by all his sons, heroes with arms like iron bars, he will do it. Let me go, brahmin; I have now laid down my weapons.

verses.text:
तथास्त्विति च तेनोक्तो मुनिनामिततेजसा ।
स तमादिश्य तनयमुत्तङ्काय महात्मने ।
क्रियतामिति राजर्षिर्जगाम वनमुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: "So be it," said the sage of immeasurable power. The royal sage then ordered his son to do as the great-souled Uttanka asked, and went to the excellent forest.

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
क एष भगवन्दैत्यो महावीर्यस्तपोधन ।
कस्य पुत्रोऽथ नप्ता वा एतदिच्छामि वेदितुम् ॥

meaning.en: Who is this daitya, revered one, of such great power, wealthy in austerity? Whose son or grandson is he? I wish to know.

verses.text:
एवं महाबलो दैत्यो न श्रुतो मे तपोधन ।
एतदिच्छामि भगवन्याथातथ्येन वेदितुम् ।
सर्वमेव महाप्राज्ञ विस्तरेण तपोधन ॥

meaning.en: I have not heard of such a mighty daitya, wealthy in austerity. I wish to know this exactly, revered one, all of it, wise one, in full.

verses.text: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

meaning.en: Markandeya said:

verses.text:
शृणु राजन्निदं सर्वं यथावृत्तं नराधिप ।
एकार्णवे तदा घोरे नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे ।
प्रनष्टेषु च भूतेषु सर्वेषु भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Listen, king, lord of men, to all this as it happened. At that time, when there was only one dreadful ocean and everything moving and unmoving had perished, and all beings were gone, best of the Bharatas,

verses.text:
प्रभवः सर्वभूतानां शाश्वतः पुरुषोऽव्ययः ।
सुष्वाप भगवान्विष्णुरप्शय्यामेक एव ह ।
नागस्य भोगे महति शेषस्यामिततेजसः ॥

meaning.en: the source of all beings, the eternal, imperishable Person, the blessed Vishnu, slept alone on a bed of water, on the great coils of the serpent Shesha of immeasurable power.

verses.text:
लोककर्ता महाभाग भगवानच्युतो हरिः ।
नागभोगेन महता परिरभ्य महीमिमाम् ॥

meaning.en: The blessed unfallen Hari, maker of the worlds, great one, lay with the great coils of the serpent embracing this earth.

verses.text:
स्वपतस्तस्य देवस्य पद्मं सूर्यसमप्रभम् ।
नाभ्यां विनिःसृतं तत्र यत्रोत्पन्नः पितामहः ।
साक्षाल्लोकगुरुर्ब्रह्मा पद्मे सूर्येन्दुसप्रभे ॥

meaning.en: As that god slept, a lotus shining like the sun came forth from his navel; there the grandfather was born, Brahma himself, teacher of the world, on the lotus bright as sun and moon.

verses.text:
चतुर्वेदश्चतुर्मूर्तिस्तथैव च चतुर्मुखः ।
स्वप्रभावाद्दुराधर्षो महाबलपराक्रमः ॥

meaning.en: Four-Vedaed, four-formed and four-faced, hard to assail by his own power and of great strength and valour.

verses.text:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य दानवौ वीर्यवत्तरौ ।
मधुश्च कैटभश्चैव दृष्टवन्तौ हरिं प्रभुम् ॥

meaning.en: After some time two very mighty danavas, Madhu and Kaitabha, saw the lord Hari

verses.text:
शयानं शयने दिव्ये नागभोगे महाद्युतिम् ।
बहुयोजनविस्तीर्णे बहुयोजनमायते ॥

meaning.en: lying on a divine bed on the serpent's coils, brilliant, spread over many leagues in width and length.

verses.text:
किरीटकौस्तुभधरं पीतकौशेयवाससम् ।
दीप्यमानं श्रिया राजंस्तेजसा वपुषा तथा ।
सहस्रसूर्यप्रतिममद्भुतोपमदर्शनम् ॥

meaning.en: He wore a crown and the Kaustubha jewel, and yellow silk garments, king, shining with beauty, radiance and form, like a thousand suns, a wondrous sight.

verses.text:
विस्मयः सुमहानासीन्मधुकैटभयोस्तदा ।
दृष्ट्वा पितामहं चैव पद्मे पद्मनिभेक्षणम् ॥

meaning.en: Madhu and Kaitabha were then greatly amazed to see the grandfather on the lotus, lotus-eyed.

verses.text:
वित्रासयेतामथ तौ ब्रह्माणममितौजसम् ।
वित्रास्यमानो बहुशो ब्रह्मा ताभ्यां महायशाः ।
अकम्पयत्पद्मनालं ततोऽबुध्यत केशवः ॥

meaning.en: They then began to terrify Brahma of boundless energy. Terrified by them again and again, the greatly renowned Brahma shook the lotus stalk, and Keshava awoke.

verses.text:
अथापश्यत गोविन्दो दानवौ वीर्यवत्तरौ ।
दृष्ट्वा तावब्रवीद्देवः स्वागतं वां महाबलौ ।
ददानि वां वरं श्रेष्ठं प्रीतिर्हि मम जायते ॥

meaning.en: Then Govinda saw the two very mighty danavas. Seeing them, the god said, "Welcome to you, mighty ones. I will give you the best boon, for I feel affection for you."

verses.text:
तौ प्रहस्य हृषीकेशं महावीर्यौ महासुरौ ।
प्रत्यब्रूतां महाराज सहितौ मधुसूदनम् ॥

meaning.en: Those two very powerful great demons laughed and together replied to Hrishikesha, slayer of Madhu, great king.

verses.text:
आवां वरय देव त्वं वरदौ स्वः सुरोत्तम ।
दातारौ स्वो वरं तुभ्यं तद्ब्रवीह्यविचारयन् ॥

meaning.en: "You choose a boon, god; we are the givers of boons, best of gods. We will give you a boon; say it without hesitation."

verses.text: भगवानुवाच

meaning.en: The blessed one said:

verses.text:
प्रतिगृह्णे वरं वीरावीप्सितश्च वरो मम ।
युवां हि वीर्यसंपन्नौ न वामस्ति समः पुमान् ॥

meaning.en: I accept a boon, heroes, and the boon I want is this: you are endowed with power and no man is your equal.

verses.text:
वध्यत्वमुपगच्छेतां मम सत्यपराक्रमौ ।
एतदिच्छाम्यहं कामं प्राप्तुं लोकहिताय वै ॥

meaning.en: Let the two of you, true in prowess, come to be killed by me. This is the wish I want fulfilled, for the good of the worlds.

verses.text: मधुकैटभावूचतुः

meaning.en: Madhu and Kaitabha said:

verses.text:
अनृतं नोक्तपूर्वं नौ स्वैरेष्वपि कुतोऽन्यथा ।
सत्ये धर्मे च निरतौ विद्ध्यावां पुरुषोत्तम ॥

meaning.en: We have never spoken untruth before, not even in play, so how now? Know us, best of persons, to be devoted to truth and dharma.

verses.text:
बले रूपे च वीर्ये च शमे च न समोऽस्ति नौ ।
धर्मे तपसि दाने च शीलसत्त्वदमेषु च ॥

meaning.en: In strength, beauty, valour and calm we have no equal, nor in dharma, austerity, giving, good conduct, courage and self-control.

verses.text:
उपप्लवो महानस्मानुपावर्तत केशव ।
उक्तं प्रतिकुरुष्व त्वं कालो हि दुरतिक्रमः ॥

meaning.en: A great calamity has come upon us, Keshava; do as you have said, for time is hard to overcome.

verses.text:
आवामिच्छावहे देव कृतमेकं त्वया विभो ।
अनावृतेऽस्मिन्नाकाशे वधं सुरवरोत्तम ॥

meaning.en: We wish, god, lord, that you do one thing for us: kill us in this sky where nothing covers us, best of gods.

verses.text:
पुत्रत्वमभिगच्छाव तव चैव सुलोचन ।
वर एष वृतो देव तद्विद्धि सुरसत्तम ॥

meaning.en: And let us become your sons too, fair-eyed one. This is the boon we choose, god; know that, best of the gods.

verses.text: भगवानुवाच

meaning.en: The blessed one said:

verses.text: बाढमेवं करिष्यामि सर्वमेतद्भविष्यति ॥

meaning.en: Very well, I will do so; all this will be.

verses.text: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

meaning.en: Markandeya said:

verses.text:
विचिन्त्य त्वथ गोविन्दो नापश्यद्यदनावृतम् ।
अवकाशं पृथिव्यां वा दिवि वा मधुसूदनः ॥

meaning.en: Thinking, Govinda found no uncovered space either on earth or in the sky, slayer of Madhu.

verses.text:
स्वकावनावृतावूरू दृष्ट्वा देववरस्तदा ।
मधुकैटभयो राजञ्शिरसी मधुसूदनः ।
चक्रेण शितधारेण न्यकृन्तत महायशाः ॥

meaning.en: Then the best of gods saw his own two thighs, uncovered, and, king, the greatly renowned slayer of Madhu cut off the heads of Madhu and Kaitabha with his sharp-edged discus.
